heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear, with some clouds late through NY, into Quebec and in VT from the Green Mountains west. Colder.Lows in the 20s, near 30 around Burlington, a few teens in the cold hollow. Winds becoming light and variable, turning to the south in the Champlain Valley up to 10 mph.

heading: Tuesday
text: Areas of morning clouds, especially from the Green Mountains west, and the international border north, then mostly sunny. Highs in the upper 40s and low 50s. West winds 10 mph west of the Greens, gusting to 15 mphthrough the Champlain Valley.

heading: Tuesday Night
text: Mostly clear besides clouds spread south of the border after midnight. Lows in the 30s, near 40 around Lake Champlain. Light west winds, less than 5 mph.
